title: Research: save 62 CK primitives per orientation by relocating one scale (no new kappa)
head: b6d6934092c063ab2575ebee00f48bbc7b1c9d82
body:
The selected #626 CK cleanup doubles register 97 before 37 additions that read it. Moving that doubling after the additions and doubling their coefficients preserves the complete register map and saves **62 real-component primitives per orientation** under the retained binary-Horner lowering.

**Status: finite complex-supplier circuit improvement / research note; no new κ.**

| Complete CK program | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Forward real primitives | 224,938 | 224,876 |
| Inverse-transpose real primitives | 224,986 | 224,924 |

Both exact positive prefix bounds remain unchanged at 40 and 62 bits. Source reads, coefficient preparation, signed accumulation, private clearing and the relocated scale are charged. Helpers, frames, recursive child profiles, wrappers and macro counts remain unchanged.

Only `research/complex-ck-scaling-fold/` is added. It contains an executable local-program reconstruction, exact certificate, proof and accounting note, independent checker, local sprint claim and validation record. The selected emitter, global invoice, frontier and `upstream/` are unchanged; production integration remains a separate obligation.

The completed search prices **all 123 scales × 8,309 positions = 1,022,007 single-scale relocations** of the pinned cleanup word. Its best complex-component delta is −31. An independent valuation-only implementation finds the same bound and all 644 minimizing placements. The chosen witness has the shortest displacement. This bound applies only to the stated fixed-word, single-relocation, original-Horner class, not arbitrary circuit synthesis or multiple relocations.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/complex-ck-scaling-fold/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_CK_SINGLE_SCALE_RELOCATION candidates=1022007 saving=62/62 columns=38/38 controls=6`.

`python3 -B research/complex-ck-scaling-fold/independent.py` separately checks all placements with dyadic valuations, both 38-column boundary maps using exact integer arithmetic, and eight adverse controls. The surrounding 678 register columns are unaffected by the changed interval.

Validation passed on macOS arm64 with CPython 3.14.8, including isolated optimized execution, invocation outside the repository, alternate gzip packaging, source/certificate rejection controls, selected-record verification and staged whitespace checks. Full `make verify`, cold selected replay, global admission, Lean and remote Linux were not run. Inherited all-size/compiler/realization/hosting/precision/tape/analytic assumptions remain; finite replay is not a formal multiplication theorem.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Selected #626 source: `660de893d27bb7abd1d5b01b1640207528a5c851`; #622: `f69477f4f6d3c7eb1f740b166881bffed4ffa9f6`; retained #543: `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Consumed sources have full SHA-256 pins.

OS assignment seed **34** selected the complex track and CK. No pinned sprint issue existed, so the claim is local. The pre-submission refresh covered 566 open PRs through #747. Related #696/#723/#734 change within-macro lowering, #722/#739 share private coefficient work, #719 studies repeated-addition fusion, and #698 changes B frames. This contribution relocates a live CK cleanup scale and supplies an exhaustive class-specific optimum. No pending implementation is imported and savings are not asserted additive without a composed recount.
